dedupe_keys.name: rosprirodnadzor groro state register of waste disposal facilities in russia landfills and storage sites with purpose waste codes and operator

description: GRORO is Russia's official state register of waste disposal facilities, the landfills and storage sites used to bury or store waste. It is kept by Rosprirodnadzor, the federal environmental supervision service. Each entry gives the region, the facility's register number and name, whether it is used for burial or storage of waste, the waste types it accepts with their codes in the federal waste classification catalogue, whether negative environmental impact information exists, the OKATO territorial code and nearest settlement, and the operating organisation with its address. The open data version read reflects the register at 13 December 2022 and holds about 4,400 records. It is free and available to download as CSV from Rosprirodnadzor's open data section, with a passport and structure file. Caveats: the data have not been refreshed since December 2022, sites have no coordinates, waste code fields span several lines and need careful parsing, and capacity and remaining volume are not given. Simulation uses: building the disposal node layer of national or regional waste flow models, locating landfills for exposure to floods, permafrost thaw or wildfire, and checking where waste can be diverted when sites close. Related records: the HIFLD solid waste landfills (data-hifld-open) and the Italian municipal waste data (data-ispra-catasto-rifiuti-municipal-waste) are waste facility and flow sources for other countries.
